headline_findings.title: Wikipedia B11 last wall (EGL BAD_ALLOC) is NOT safely fixable in the runtime JAR
headline_findings.proof: delegate adapter.window.WindowSessionAdapter (oh-adapter-framework.jar, md5 5bfa99ba = live board jar) reverse-pushes IWindow.resized on a SIZE gate: `long sizeKey=((long)w<<32)|(h&0xffffffffL); Long lastPushed=mLastPushedSize.get(sessionId); if(lastPushed==null||lastPushed.longValue()!=sizeKey){push;put}`. Pure-reflection 'size-gate -> once-per-window' is impossible: (1) compare unboxes via lastPushed.longValue() (primitive !=), so no equals-sentinel; (2) Long is final, cannot override longValue(); (3) delegate check-casts get() result to Long, so a non-Long poison throws CCE inside relayout; (4) sizeKey is a relayout-internal local, my WindowSessionProxy post-processing cannot see or predict it before the delegate's own push. Confirmed by source (line 848) AND cc-wiki independent smali read (.line 839-840). Changing relayout input args (requestedWH 0x0 -> useWH) was forbidden by directive (WRAP_CONTENT semantics).
headline_findings.westlake_correct_form: vm-copies/westlake-current/framework/window/java/WindowSessionAdapter.java:1076-1081 gates by window.asBinder() once-per-window ([G2.8-RELAYOUT-LOOP]); route-A build regressed to the size gate.
headline_findings.recommended_fix: cx-t0 native libhwui single-swap westlake-b11-egl-a578b949 (colorspace-retry + eglGetError) — addresses EGL surface recreation at root regardless of push count; OR rebuild oh-adapter-framework.jar WindowSessionAdapter to the binder gate (boot-AOT, needs boot recompile, not single-file overlay).
headline_findings.my_r17j_status: 0x0-degenerate once-per-window reverse-push in WindowSessionProxy is a DIFFERENT path (only fires on degenerate frames), correct for ZigZag, retained, NOT the EGL cause.

headline_findings.title: conscrypt 'Sun provider not found' is boot-side (JAR signature verification), r17k cannot reach it
headline_findings.proof: App startup triggers JAR verification: JarVerifier.beginEntry -> ManifestEntryVerifier.setEntry -> ManifestEntryVerifier$SunProviderHolder.<clinit> -> sun.security.jca.Providers.getSunProvider(:128) `Class.forName("com.android.org.conscrypt.OpenSSLProvider")` -> ClassNotFoundException -> RuntimeException(:135) 'Sun provider not found'. Providers is a BCP class so Class.forName uses BootClassLoader, which cannot see the runtime-JAR OpenSSLProvider (r17k). AppConfig.<clinit> (amaze) / main (newpipe) die on the resulting ExceptionInInitializerError/NoClassDefFoundError.
headline_findings.recommended_fix: cx-t0 boot: patch sun.security.jca.Providers.getSunProvider() (core-oj.jar) to return the BouncyCastle provider instead of Class.forName-ing conscrypt, OR ship com.android.org.conscrypt.OpenSSLProvider in a boot jar. AppSpawnXInit.overrideJcaProvidersForOH already fixes the Providers.<clinit> provider-LIST path (Security.props rewrite) but NOT this lazy JAR-verification getSunProvider path.
headline_findings.note: r17k OpenSSLProvider still fixes the APP-SIDE case (app code `new com.android.org.conscrypt.OpenSSLProvider()`, app classloader, e.g. vlc). Two distinct walls, same class name.
